questions.question: What can help if your drive chain slips?
questions.explanation: If your chain slips, try tightening it. If tightening does not fix the problem, replace the chain before riding again.

questions.question: What type of sign is rectangular?
questions.explanation: Speed limit and other regulatory signs are rectangular with white background and black lettering. You must follow the rules on these signs.

questions.question: What type of sign is yellow with black lettering or symbols?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They alert riders about upcoming road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The group will exit at the next exit

questions.explanation: When the lead rider raises their left arm with index finger extended, it means the group should ride in a single-file line. Hand signals are important for group communication.

questions.question: How should you choose your lane position?

options.text: Always ride in the center of the lane
Always ride on the left side of the lane
Always ride on the right side of the lane
Change your position based on different conditions

questions.correctAnswerText: Change your position based on different conditions
questions.explanation: There is no single best lane position. Choose the position where you are most likely to be seen and can keep safe space around you.

questions.question: Where do most conflicts happen between motorcycles and other vehicles?
questions.explanation: Most conflicts happen at intersections. Stay alert where other vehicles might cross your path.

questions.question: To ride safely on slippery surfaces, which of these should you NOT do?

options.text: Avoid the center of the lane on wet roads

questions.explanation: On slippery surfaces, reduce speed, avoid sudden movements, and use both brakes when needed. Watch for oil, gravel, dirt, and wet or frozen areas.

questions.question: What does making eye contact with a driver mean?

options.text: It is not worth the effort
It does not guarantee they will yield to you
They will always yield to you

questions.correctAnswerText: It does not guarantee they will yield to you
questions.explanation: Do not assume eye contact means a driver will yield. Drivers often look directly at a motorcycle but do not notice it is there.

questions.question: For eye or face shield protection to work well, it must have all of these qualities EXCEPT:

options.text: Be too tight to wear sunglasses or eyeglasses

questions.correctAnswerText: Be too tight to wear sunglasses or eyeglasses
questions.explanation: A good eye or face shield must be scratch-free, hard to penetrate, allow side vision, fasten securely, allow air flow to prevent fogging, and have room for eyeglasses or sunglasses.

questions.question: When is it a good idea to wear reflective clothing?
questions.explanation: Wear reflective and bright clothing anytime you ride. Crashes happen day and night, so stay visible at all times.

questions.question: A passenger should never:
questions.explanation: In South Carolina, passengers under 21 must wear a helmet and eye protection. All riders should wear helmets. Passengers must avoid loose clothing that could catch on the motorcycle. Passengers should lean with the operator when turning. Passengers must never ride sidesaddle.

questions.question: A major effect of alcohol is:
questions.explanation: Alcohol is a depressant. It slows down your body and mind, affecting both physical and mental abilities.

questions.question: To control a motorcycle properly, you should:

options.text: Sit so your arms steer the motorcycle, not hold you up.
Sit far back so you can keep your arms straight.
Keep your knees away from the gas tank.
Drag your feet on the ground.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sit so your arms steer the motorcycle, not hold you up.
questions.explanation: Sit so your arms control the motorcycle instead of just holding you up. Your arms should bend slightly at the grips. Keep your knees against the gas tank and your feet on the footrests to help balance.

questions.question: An effective eye or face shield should have all of the following, except:
questions.explanation: Good eye protection must be free of scratches, resist impacts, provide clear side vision, fasten securely, allow air to pass through, and leave room for eyeglasses or sunglasses underneath.

questions.question: Reflective clothing should:

options.text: Only be worn during the day.

questions.explanation: Bright and reflective clothing helps others see you anytime. Most motorcycle crashes happen in daylight, so wear bright clothing during the day too.

questions.question: Which of the following is not protective riding gear?
questions.explanation: Good protective gear includes a jacket and pants made of leather or another strong material, boots that cover and support your ankles, and hearing protection even with a helmet.

questions.question: Where is the throttle usually located?
questions.explanation: The throttle is on the right handle grip. Know where all your motorcycle controls are before you ride.

questions.question: Where is the front brake lever usually located?
questions.explanation: The front brake lever is on the right handgrip. Know where all your motorcycle controls are located before riding.

questions.question: The front brake:

options.text: Provides less than half of your braking power.
Provides about 70 percent of your braking power.
Should only be used when the road is wet.
Should be the only brake you use.

questions.correctAnswerText: Provides about 70 percent of your braking power.
questions.explanation: The front brake is much more powerful than the rear brake and provides about 70 percent of your stopping power. Use both brakes every time you slow down or stop.

questions.question: Which of the following protects your eyes from the wind?
questions.explanation: Goggles and face shields protect your eyes from the wind. Windshields, eyeglasses, and sunglasses do not provide enough protection.

questions.question: If your front wheel skids while braking, what should you do?

options.text: Release the front brake right away and apply it smoothly again.
Release the front brake and use only the rear brake.
Release both brakes and let the bike slow down on its own.

questions.correctAnswerText: Release the front brake right away and apply it smoothly again.
questions.explanation: If your front wheel locks up while braking, release the front brake immediately and apply it smoothly again.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what should motorcyclists do?

options.text: They do not need space around them.
They should add more space around them.
They should use half their normal space.
They should keep enough space around each rider.

questions.correctAnswerText: They should keep enough space around each rider.
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, keep the group together but always maintain enough space around each rider for safety.

questions.question: Which action will NOT help stop a friend from driving drunk?

options.text: Arrange a safe ride home for them.
Keep them busy with activities to slow their drinking and let them sober up.
Tell them to wait 15 minutes after their last drink before driving.
Ask other friends to help stop them from driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tell them to wait 15 minutes after their last drink before driving.
questions.explanation: Good ways to stop drunk driving include arranging a safe ride, keeping them busy, making excuses to keep them from leaving, and getting friends to help. Waiting 15 minutes does not make it safe to drive after drinking.

questions.question: More than half of all motorcycle crashes involve:
questions.explanation: More than half of motorcycle crashes happen to riders with less than six months of experience. Most crashes occur during the day when riders are going slower speeds.

questions.question: Which clothing helps other drivers see you?
questions.explanation: Wear gear that makes you and your motorcycle easier to see. Bright, reflective clothing helps other drivers spot you on the road.
